review.why: Audits dbt documentation coverage and drafts missing model and column descriptions in the project's own style, one folder at a time, for human review.
review.summary: Runs a coverage audit from the parsed manifest, then drafts descriptions that copy the project's conventions: layout, description style, column depth and test placement. It works folder by folder, leaves every change for review and never commits or pushes. A greenfield fallback uses grain-first descriptions.
strengths: Mirrors existing house style instead of imposing a template
cautions: Later workflow steps were not read here
Drafted descriptions still need a person who knows the data
Only counts columns declared in YAML
